title: Chickpea & Coriander Burgers
description: Plant-based patties bound with egg and breadcrumbs, bright with lemon zest and cumin.
ingredients: Tomato, cucumber and chilli sauce to serve
steps: Blend the chickpeas, lemon, cumin, half the coriander, egg and seasoning.
Mix with breadcrumbs and diced onion, then form 4 patties and chill 10 minutes.
Fry 4 minutes per side, then build the burgers with the remaining toppings.

source.label: Adapted from BBC Good Food chickpea & coriander burgers

notes: Chilling the patties before frying keeps them from falling apart — chickpeas add about 6g of fiber per burger.
